_about: Public-domain Francis Xavier Weninger (1805-1888), Austrian-born Jesuit missionary preacher in the United States, for the Word Hoard: his English books only: A Manual of the Catholic Religion, Catholicity Protestantism and Infidelity, Easter in Heaven, On the Apostolical and Infallible Authority of the Pope, Photographic Views, Lives of the Saints (2 vols.), Original Short and Practical Sermons for every Sunday, Original Conferences, and two short polemics. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 88 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

weninger-manual: A manual of the Catholic religion for catechists, teachers and self-instruction ([n.p.], 1861)
weninger-catholicity: Catholicity, protestantism and infidelity. An appeal to candid Americans (N.Y., O'Shea, 1861)
weninger-easter-heaven: Easter in heaven (New York : D. and J. Sadler, 1863)
weninger-pope-authority: On the apostolical and infallible authority of the Pope : when teaching the faithful, and on his relation to a general council (New York : D.& J. Sadlier ; Cincinnati, OH : J.P. Walsh, 1868)
weninger-photographic-views: Photographic views : or, Religious and moral truths reflected in the universe (New York : P. O'Shea, 1873)
weninger-pharisees: The pharisees and persecutors of the Church in our days : a sermon preached on Easter Sunday, 1875 / by F.X. Weninger (P. O'Shea, 1875)
weninger-lives-saints-1: Lives of the Saints,with a Practical Instruction on the Life of each Saints, for every  day in the year, vol. 1 (P. O'Shea, New York, 1877)
weninger-lives-saints-2: Lives of the saints, with a practical instruction on the life of each saint, for every day in year, vol. 2 (New York, P. O'Shea, 1877)
weninger-reply-thompson: Reply to Hon. R.W. Thompson, Secretary of the Navy, addressed to the American people (New York : P. O'Shea, 1877)
weninger-sunday-sermons: Original, short and practical sermons for every Sunday of the ecclesiastical year (Cincinnati : C. J. H. Lowen, 1881)
weninger-conferences: Original, short and practical conferences : containing thirty-six conferences ... intended as a three year's course (Cincinnati, OH : [s.n, 1883)
